name: hud_ui_mgr_set_float_timer_visible
description: HudUiMgr::SetFloatTimerVisible toggles the floating timer panel and reactivates the current layout when hiding it.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD manager/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x413770 validates dispatching SetVisible through g_HudUiMgrTimerPanelFloat ftable slot 0x60 with 1 for non-zero input, dispatching the same slot with 0 for zero input, and calling HudUiMgr::TriggerCurrentLayoutOnActivated only on the zero-input path.

The native smoke verifies the floating timer panel SetVisible dispatch order and arguments for visible and hidden inputs, and verifies that current-layout activation is skipped for visible input and performed once when hiding the panel.
